title: CoDeQ: Compression with a Dead-Zone Quantizer for Differentiable Joint Pruning--Quantization
abstract: arXiv:2512.12981v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Joint pruning and quantization can reduce the inference cost of neural-networks, but determining layerwise sparsity and precision often requires auxiliary allocation procedures and considerable hyperparameter tuning. We introduce CoDeQ, a quantization-aware training method that unifies pruning and quantization through a learnable dead-zone quantizer. Its learned dead-zone width controls layerwise sparsity, while bit widths can be held fixed or learned in mixed-precision mode. A pruning-aware scale allocates all available nonzero reconstruction levels over the retained range. We derive the spacing that minimizes worst-case reconstruction error over this range for a fixed bit width and range endpoint. Model weights and compression parameters are optimized jointly under one global compression coefficient, with a shared learning rate for the compression parameters. On VGG7/CIFAR-10, CoDeQ with 2-bit activations achieves 0.05% relative BO

translated_title: CoDeQ：使用死区量化器实现可微联合剪枝与量化的模型压缩
translated_abstract: 联合剪枝与量化可以降低神经网络的推理成本，但确定各层的稀疏度与精度通常需要辅助的分配流程以及大量的超参数调优。我们提出CoDeQ，这是一种量化感知训练方法，通过一个可学习的死区量化器将剪枝与量化统一起来。其学习到的死区宽度可以控制各层的稀疏度，而位宽既可以保持固定，也可以在混合精度模式下进行学习。一个剪枝感知的缩放因子会在保留的范围内分配所有可用的非零重建电平。我们推导了在固定位宽和范围端点条件下，能够最小化该范围内最坏情况重建误差的间距。模型权重与压缩参数在一个全局压缩系数下联合优化，压缩参数共享同一学习率。在VGG7/CIFAR-10上，使用2位激活的CoDeQ实现了0.05%的相对……
tldr: 该论文提出CoDeQ，通过可学习的死区量化器将剪枝与量化统一在同一训练框架中，以死区宽度控制逐层稀疏度并支持可学习的混合精度位宽，在单一全局压缩系数下联合优化权重与压缩参数，从而省去辅助分配流程和大量超参数调优。
en_tdlr: CoDeQ unifies pruning and quantization through a learnable dead-zone quantizer, where the dead-zone width controls layerwise sparsity and supports learnable mixed precision, jointly optimizing weights and compression parameters under a single global coefficient without auxiliary allocation procedures or extensive hyperparameter tuning.
